steps.instruction: Pay the SK309 fare of 574.64 USD to billing account ACCT-SAX-1731 with memo 'flight booking'. SK309 is the cheapest flight (NO481 is 607.01, ME452 is 1203.73).
Pay 6 nights at Pine Court Hotel: 125.80 x 6 = 754.80 USD to billing account ACCT-PCH-3716 with memo 'hotel booking'. Pine Court is the cheapest hotel (The Linden 234.63, Atlas Suites 238.09).
Set KV key trip/total to 1329.44 (574.64 flight + 754.80 hotel), formatted with 2 decimals.
